title: Echo: a new legend?
description: Get ready to be spooked, this is the start of a series called Legends: Retold? Where it retells famous creepypasta characters and makes new ones!
body:
**Something is wrong with your world.**

After you think you've won, **Echo** begins to appear at the edge of your vision—never quite close enough, never fully gone. The air thickens into unnatural fog, distant sounds feel swallowed, and every move you make starts to feel... copied.

Echo is a psychological horror encounter for Minecraft. It stalks, waits, and mirrors your behavior in subtle, corrupted ways before closing in for a jumpscare finish. Death isn't the end either—its presence lingers, and the world can spiral into a broken, hostile state.

### Why players install Echo-Mod

- **Creepy atmospheric pressure** instead of cheap spam.
- **Reactive stalker behavior** that responds to what you do.
- **Corruption-style progression** that escalates the longer the encounter lasts.
- **Custom death flavor and horror events** designed for singleplayer storytelling.

This is the start of a series called **Legends: Retold?** Where it retells famous creepypasta characters such as herobrine and entity 303 and makes new ones like Echo!

### Please Read

***Warning***: **this will crash your game intentionally!** As prt of the mod it crashes your game. To disable this please run the command `/gamerule modFeaturesWillEventuallyCrashGame true`, this will disable all of the corruption, spawning and most of the mod's features.

**Try and not use this on worlds you have put a lot of work into.**
